title: company.json
description: Schema for the Company Profile containing financial and operational data extracted from SEC filings.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g., TSM, ASML, NVDA)

business_model.description: The primary semiconductor business model category.

gross_margin_percent.description: Gross margin percentage reported in the latest filing.

capex.description: Capital expenditure reported (in absolute base currency).

citations.description: Exact source citations from the 10-K/20-F filing. MUST include the exact page number.

gross_margin_page.description: Exact page number from the 10-K/20-F where the Gross Margin is stated. Fail evaluation if hallucinated or missing.

capex_page.description: Exact page number from the 10-K/20-F where the Capex is stated.
